# Result: Birch prints 15 cipher runs (ct_p339.tsv) and nothing past run 15. His English ends "be made, who for 31.16.37.38.27.50.51.17. should come over hither, as that must happen unavoidably." = Dutch "dije tot kennisse alhijer conden overcomen, gelijck dat onvermijdelijck geschijeden moet." then "18 July [1653. N. S.] Beverning and Nieuport." The Dutch passage "Versoecken derhalve ... te rugge comen" (p.293) and the p.294 postscript are absent from Birch: no numerals, no English.
